CustomObject.label: OI Impact Cache
CustomObject.description: Durable cache of computed Impact Analysis results, keyed by (nodeKey, direction, depth, rootVersionChecksum) — a Custom Object rather than Platform Cache because DE-7's invalidation needs "find cached rows referencing node X," which Platform Cache cannot answer without a hand-built side index. Owned exclusively by OI_ImpactCacheRepository. Application-internal (ADR-0006), same posture as OI_Graph_Node__c/OI_Graph_Edge__c. Recreated under this name (originally OI_Impact_Analysis_Cache__c) after every field added to the original object post-creation stayed permanently invisible to SOQL/DML despite deploying and describing correctly — an entTrial-specific platform propagation issue tied to that object's own describe cache, not this app's metadata; see Backlog.md's Dependency Engine epic notes.
